g.text: The credentials are sent to the
Auth Service in exchange for a JWT
After sign-in, the SPA router opens the catalog
The Checkout API returns the catalog and stock status
the catalog, without a page change
The payment token and order are sent,
and a lock prevents double submission
The backend calls Stripe to charge the card
Signing in and getting a token
The user submits credentials. The Auth Service verifies them and issues a JWT, then the app opens the
Loading products and opening the payment dialog
The catalog loads current stock from the API. Clicking Checkout opens the payment dialog.
The user confirms the order. The Checkout API calls Stripe to authorize the payment.
The payment is approved, so the dialog closes and the confirmation page opens.
